scope: Domestic, non-EMI, supported purchase categories. Indicative cashback subject to merchant MCC and issuers' actual terms.

cards.name: CASHBACK SBI Card

excl.fuel: No card cashback on fuel purchases (fuel surcharge waiver is not included).
excl.utilities: No card cashback on utility payments.

cards.caveat: Other exclusions include insurance, rent, wallets, education, jewellery, railways, government spends, gaming, tolls and EMI transactions. Merchant MCC classification determines eligibility.
cards.review_note: Reviewed against issuer FAQ, product description and revision effective 1 April 2026; student team should independently reconfirm before assessed submission.

cards.name: HSBC Live+ Credit Card

excl.fuel: No regular cashback on fuel transactions; conditional fuel promotions are excluded.

cards.caveat: The ₹1,200 accelerated cap is shared across eligible categories each billing cycle. Merchant MCC governs eligibility. Shopping on Amazon, Flipkart and Myntra earns 1.5%, not 10%. Some utility MCCs earn 0%. The fallback on accelerated spend after the shared cap is not established in this catalogue.
cards.review_note: Reviewed against issuer India Live+ page and service guide. Merchant MCC determines boosted or excluded reward. Student team should reconfirm current conditions before submission.
